Signature BBQ

Straight off the charcoal grill — the four names Ichhra keeps coming back for.

House Favourite

Nublets

Bite-size chicken pieces grilled golden over the coals — juicy inside, lightly charred at the edges, and dangerously easy to keep eating.

From the Grill

Grill Fish

Whole fish seasoned and grilled over open flame until the skin crisps and the flesh stays soft, smoky and full of flavour.

Charcoal Classic

Chicken Seekh Kabab

Hand-rolled minced chicken skewers, grilled over glowing coals for that deep char and smoky bite in every mouthful.

Creamy & Mild

Malai Boti

Tender chicken cubes in a rich, creamy marinade — melt-in-the-mouth soft, gently spiced, and finished on the grill.

Three Ways to Enjoy

Sit down with family, grab it on the go, or get it delivered hot to your door.

Dine-In

Settle in at Sultan Ahmed Road and eat your BBQ the way it should be eaten — straight off the grill, still sizzling.

Takeaway

Delivery

Late-night craving? Azan delivers — including through the night on our 24-hour days. One call and the grill comes to you.
